description: This file documents the 'AndroidDevice' class in a Markdown format, including methods, events, properties, and related information for automating and interacting with Android devices in the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: AndroidDevice
classes.description: Represents a connected Android device, either physical or emulated, providing methods to control and retrieve information from the device.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Disconnects from the device.

methods.name: drag
methods.description: Drags a widget defined by a selector towards a specified destination point.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills a specified input box with given text.

methods.name: fling
methods.description: Performs a fling action on a widget in a specified direction.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns information about a widget specified by a selector.

methods.name: installApk
methods.description: Installs an APK on the device.

methods.name: launchBrowser
methods.description: Launches the Chrome browser in a persistent context on the device.

methods.name: longTap
methods.description: Performs a long tap on a widget specified by a selector.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Returns the device model.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Launches a shell process and returns a socket for communication.

methods.name: pinchClose
methods.description: Pinches closed a widget.

methods.name: pinchOpen
methods.description: Pinches open a widget.

methods.name: press
methods.description: Presses a specific key within a widget.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Copies a file to the device.

methods.name: screenshot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of the device, optionally saving it to a path.

methods.name: scroll
methods.description: Scrolls a widget in a specified direction.

methods.name: serial
methods.description: Returns the device serial number.

methods.name: setDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Sets a default maximum timeout for all methods accepting a timeout option.

methods.name: shell
methods.description: Executes a shell command on the device.

methods.name: swipe
methods.description: Swipes a widget in a specified direction.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Taps on a widget specified by a selector.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for a widget to appear or disappear depending on the state option.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specified event to fire with optional predicate filtering.

methods.name: webView
methods.description: Waits for an AndroidWebView matching criteria to open and returns it.

methods.name: webViews
methods.description: Returns an array of currently open WebViews.
